title: Gochujang Yogurt Sauce for Tuna Poke Bowl
description: A tangy, spicy-sweet drizzle sauce built on 0% Greek yogurt instead of mayo — thick, fast, and no cooking required.
ingredients: 1 teaspoon (5ml) reduced-sodium soy sauce or tamari
instructions: In a medium bowl, whisk together 1/2 cup (120g) plain 0% Greek yogurt and 2 tablespoons (36g) gochujang paste until smooth.
Add 1 tablespoon (20g) maple syrup, 1 teaspoon (4.5g) sesame oil, 1 tablespoon (15ml) rice vinegar, and 1 teaspoon (5ml) reduced-sodium soy sauce. Whisk to combine.
Stir in 1 clove garlic (minced), 1/2 teaspoon fresh ginger (grated), and the juice of 1 lime (about 1 tablespoon).
Thin with 1-2 tablespoons water until pourable and drizzle-able — start with 1 tablespoon and add more as needed.
Taste: add extra gochujang for heat, extra maple for sweetness.
Drizzle over tuna poke bowl, about 3-4 tablespoons per serving. Store leftovers in an airtight container in the fridge for up to 5 days.
notes: Sodium runs ~270mg per serving from the gochujang and soy sauce combined — ease off the soy sauce if you're watching sodium that day. Sauce thickens in the fridge; whisk in a splash of water before serving again.
